pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are large, irregularly polygonal with primarily obtuse internal angles. Edge gradients are relatively smooth and continuous. Dark patches dominate the spatial area relative to the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous network of thin pathways. Junction nodes typically feature three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is narrow and uniform across the visible flank and neck surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The upper neck contour exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, consistent with a short mane structure.
